meta.project_name: Say it, get paid (AI Builder's Day '26)
meta.summary: Who can do what, and what switches a capability on. Registry only, like Synacor's tenant-capabilities.json: domain files own entities and journeys; this file owns gates, capabilities and the access matrix.

gate_kinds.name: Owner of a workspace
gate_kinds.description: The request carries a valid workspace cookie. This is the only identity in the product.
gate_kinds.default_if_unknown: off: owner pages redirect to /start, owner APIs return 401

gate_kinds.name: Holder of an invoice link
gate_kinds.description: Knowing an invoice's public slug grants read access to that one invoice. The slug is the secret.

gate_kinds.name: Integration key present
gate_kinds.description: An env var on the server turns an integration on. Missing keys degrade to a fallback rather than break the flow, except where noted.

gate_kinds.name: GST registration
gate_kinds.description: Whether the workspace has a valid GSTIN. Without one: GST is 0, the document is a 'Bill of supply', GST this month is hidden (OQ-SH-2).

gate_kinds.name: Cut on the day
gate_kinds.description: A capability removed under time pressure, per intent-shared cut_order. Never-cut items cannot carry this gate.

gate_kinds.name: Paid plan
gate_kinds.description: Free vs paid tier. Pricing is to test, not settled. Nothing is gated by plan today.

gate_kinds.name: Magic link
gate_kinds.description: A signed link sent to the workspace's saved email that sets the workspace cookie on a new device.

server_config.fallback: none; the app does not run

server_config.unlocks: CAP-VOICE extract, CAP-BILLS read, CAP-CODES, CAP-REMIND fallback
server_config.fallback: type the invoice; fill the bill form by hand; codes left empty
Claude drafts the reminder with our invoice link and UPI

capabilities.name: Set up a workspace
capabilities.description: Your details, what you sell with SAC/HSN codes, GSTIN check.

capabilities.name: Say an invoice
capabilities.description: Mic → Scribe → Claude extract → confirm form.
capabilities.degraded_ux: No ElevenLabs key or a mic failure → Type it. A language that failed the night-before test is cut from the copy.

capabilities.name: Save a GST invoice
capabilities.description: Confirm, number, save, post to the ledger.

capabilities.name: View and pay an invoice
capabilities.description: The public invoice page with UPI QR and Pay button.

capabilities.name: Send the invoice on WhatsApp
capabilities.description: Owner-only share bar on the public invoice: wa.me with the customer's number, or Copy.

capabilities.name: Send reminder
capabilities.description: Agent or Claude drafts a reminder; owner sends from WhatsApp.
capabilities.degraded_ux: AgenticOrg missing or failing → Claude draft → fixed template. The owner always gets a message.

capabilities.name: Pine Labs payment link
capabilities.description: Pine Labs payment gateway: the one way to pay on the invoice page and in reminders, with a webhook that marks the invoice paid.
capabilities.default_state: enabled when AgenticOrg keys are set
capabilities.degraded_ux: No gateway keys → raw UPI QR to the owner's UPI ID and manual Mark as paid.
capabilities.notes: Decided 2026-10-24 (OQ-INV-1). Link creation exists via AgenticOrg; webhook and invoice-page link not built.

capabilities.name: Mark as paid
capabilities.notes: Never-cut by implication: it is the ledger posting for payments.

capabilities.name: Snap a bill
capabilities.degraded_ux: If cut: no camera button; pitch falls back to invoices plus books; bills move to Month 1.

capabilities.name: GST this month
capabilities.degraded_ux: If cut, the ledger still records GST; Home drops the card.

capabilities.name: Landing page
gated_by: public (shown at / without a workspace cookie)

access_matrix.description: Rows are actors, columns are what they can reach. 'own' means scoped to the cookie's workspace.

can: View any invoice whose link they hold
Share and remind on own invoices
cannot: See or touch another workspace's data
Edit or delete anything after saving

can: View the one invoice they were sent
Pay by UPI or a Pine Labs link
cannot: See the owner's other invoices or books

can: Their own test workspaces as owners
Try it as an owner on their own phone

tiers.note: Free is how people try it.

other_revenue: A share of the payment fee through Pine Labs
Later: lending against invoices, through a partner

business_rules.ears: IF the workspace cookie is missing, malformed or unknown THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL redirect owner pages to /start AND return 401 from owner APIs.
IF an integration key is missing or the call fails THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL fall back (type it, fill by hand, Claude draft, template) AND SHALL NOT block saving or sharing an invoice.

business_rules.description: Never-cut capabilities can't be gated by scope-cut.
business_rules.ears: WHEN cutting scope THE SYSTEM SHALL keep voice, the confirm step, the public invoice with UPI, the ledger posting and /stats.

business_rules.description: Owner-only controls on a public page check ownership.
business_rules.ears: WHEN the public invoice is viewed by the workspace that owns it THE SYSTEM SHALL show the share bar; for anyone else it SHALL show only the invoice.
IF a request to /api/transcribe, /api/extract or /api/read-bill has no valid workspace cookie THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL return 401. /api/codes stays open for onboarding.

open_questions.plain: Can strangers burn our AI credit?
open_questions.question: /api/transcribe, /api/extract and /api/read-bill accept requests with no workspace cookie. Anyone who finds them can spend ElevenLabs and Anthropic credit. /api/codes must stay open (onboarding runs before a workspace exists). Require a workspace on the other three, and add a simple per-workspace rate limit?
open_questions.resolution: Require a workspace cookie on /api/transcribe, /api/extract and /api/read-bill. No rate limit for today. /api/codes stays open for onboarding.

open_questions.question: It shows only aggregate counts and ₹ invoiced across everyone. Public makes it easy for judges and the team. Any reason to hide it after the event?
open_questions.resolution: Public today; it shows only totals. Review after the event.

open_questions.question: See intent-shared OQ-SH-2. If yes, the 'registration' gate controls the GST rate on invoices, the document title and CAP-GST-VIEW.
open_questions.resolution: Yes, per OQ-SH-2: the registration gate sets GST to 0, titles the document 'Bill of supply', and hides CAP-GST-VIEW for workspaces without a valid GSTIN.

open_questions.question: A public slug works forever and can't be revoked. A wrong invoice sent to the wrong person stays readable. Acceptable until editing and voiding exist?
open_questions.resolution: Cancel is enough. A cancelled invoice's link shows only 'This invoice was cancelled', with no amounts or details. Links don't otherwise expire.
